guarantees.claim: process_latched is set to 1 when process_i is high and process_o is low, at rising clock edge (with reset inactive).
process_latched is cleared to 0 when process_o is high or done_i passes the mubi4 strict true test, at rising clock edge (with reset inactive).
When no other condition applies, process_latched retains its previous value (implicit register hold).
guarantees.cond: posedge clk_i, rst_ni high, not (process_i && !process_o) and not (process_o || mubi4_test_true_strict(done_i))

assumptions.risk: If done_i is asserted while the process is not truly finished, process_latched could be cleared prematurely, leading to data corruption or state machine inconsistency.
